area: Roberts Lane area north of Bakersfield, near a canal
disposition: multiple fires corralled for lack of water; water shuttled by trunk line; mop-up carried past 1:30 a.m.
summary: Crews were sent to an outside fire in the area of Beardsley Junior High at Roberts Lane and found fire burning in trash along a canal side. Crews reported two more fires nearby, one about 100 yards south, and told dispatchers they did not have enough water to put the main body of fire out, so they would try to keep it from spreading until more units arrived. Engines were routed in on dirt roads behind the houses, water was shuttled over a trunk line and the smaller section was knocked down before crews settled into mop-up.

area: Adobe Road at Teale Road, Kern County
disposition: assigned to the Station 54 area
summary: A vehicle fire was reported in the area of Adobe Road and Teale Road, just north of Teale Road, and was assigned to the Station 54 area.

area: Roberts Lane area north of Bakersfield
disposition: engine assigned; tied into the same mop-up operation
summary: Engine 64 was sent to an outside fire in the area of Beardsley Junior High at Roberts Lane, one of several trash and vegetation fires crews worked along the canal that morning.

disposition: broadcast to units; direction of travel unknown
summary: A silver 2020 Ram 2500 pickup was taken from outside a downtown hotel in the 1700 block of 18th Street. A description of the person involved went out to units, and the vehicle's direction of travel was unknown.

disposition: subject ejected from the vehicle; units code 4
summary: Officers reported a pursuit with speeds around 30 mph and light traffic yielding. Two minutes later the driver had been ejected from the vehicle and units cleared the scene.

disposition: units checked the area; not located
summary: A missing adult woman was reported to be with two toddlers, ages two and three, and had last been seen about three hours earlier. Family members said they had been unable to reach her, and units in the area reported they had not located anyone.

disposition: medical aid advised; report taken
summary: A victim came to a neighbor's door in the 1800 block of Quincy Street bleeding from the mouth and told the caller she had been assaulted by her boyfriend, who left in an unknown direction. Medical units were advised.

disposition: caller declined to be a victim; units responded
summary: A caller reported that a 15-year-old boy had waved and then pointed a possible replica firearm at him at a discount store on Rosamond Boulevard. The caller said the incident had happened about five minutes earlier and that he did not want to be a victim.

area: 6500 block of Niles Street at Lynwood Street, Bakersfield
disposition: officers responding
summary: Officers were sent to a discount store in the 6500 block of Niles Street for a man in his late 30s reported to be harassing customers in their vehicles in the parking lot.

disposition: vehicle run with no returns
summary: Units were sent northbound on Highway 99 at Rosedale Highway to check on a missing person. A 2016 coupe out of Bakersfield was run and returned no wants or stops.

area: Arlington Street area and East Frontage Lane, Bakersfield
disposition: units responding; second call at a second location
summary: A caller reported a man and a woman possibly trying to break into a yard and that a gate to the property had been broken. A few minutes later the same area drew a second call reporting that a woman was trying to break down a front door on East Frontage Lane.

disposition: balance canceled; one unit handled it
summary: Dispatchers passed word that all occupants had fled a fire. A short time later a battalion canceled the balance after a unit reported it could handle the damage.

area: 400 block of Water Street, Kern County
disposition: ambulance responding from Lamont
summary: A medical aid call went out for a back house in the 400 block of Water Street, with an ambulance responding from Lamont.

disposition: units en route; earlier call transferred to medical
summary: Units were sent to a possible domestic dispute in the 400 block of Adams Street near the railroad tracks, where a caller had earlier reported a subject yelling for help. That earlier call had been transferred to medical without further detail.

disposition: caller locked herself in a room; units responding
summary: A caller reported that a transient man in his 40s or 50s had made his way into her residence and was screaming. The caller said she had locked herself in a room while units responded.

disposition: all units requested; staged before contact
summary: Crews were sent to the 34th Street area for a behavioral health call, with dispatchers asking units to stage before contact.

disposition: caller hung up on 911; units routed in
summary: A caller rang 911 from South Oswell Street with what dispatchers described as a verbal disturbance in the background, then stopped answering questions and disconnected. Units were directed in by way of South Fairfax Road and Panama Road.

disposition: service attempted with move-out and no-contact orders
summary: Units were advised that a caller held an unserved domestic violence restraining order granted earlier in the month, and that they would also be serving a move-out order and a no-contact order.

disposition: units responding; subject known to carry a firearm
summary: A caller returned to 911 and reported that a subject was threatening multiple family members. Units were advised the subject was known to carry a firearm and that he was leaving in a silver sedan.

area: East Brundage Lane area and South Park Avenue area, Bakersfield
disposition: investigated; nothing showing
summary: Battalion 1 and several engines were sent to a structure fire in the city, where crews arrived at a two-story building of about 2,500 square feet and reported nothing showing. Crews investigated while other units staged.

disposition: engine and medical units assigned
summary: An engine and medical units were sent to south Bakersfield for a cardiac arrest call, one of several medical calls in the hours before dawn.

disposition: units responded after subjects were reported code 4
summary: Officers were sent to the 1900 block of Ming Avenue for a domestic disturbance after a caller was told the subjects at the location were code 4.

area: Sterling Road at College Avenue, Bakersfield
disposition: neighbor reported the disturbance; units responding
summary: A verbal disturbance was reported at a neighbor's residence at Sterling Road and College Avenue, where a caller could only hear a subject yelling and screaming and a juvenile crying.
